headline: A strong frontend library engineer, especially in interaction-heavy React components, with demonstrated ecosystem adoption.
evidence: sonner/src/state.ts implements a bounded toast history, subscriber replay, pending-dismissal cancellation, and same-ID update semantics, with comments documenting StrictMode and lifecycle edge cases.

sonner/test/tests/basic.spec.ts contains behavioral Playwright coverage for timeout, rejection/unwrap behavior, custom content, and swipe dismissal; sonner also has CI and 37 releases across 1,264 days.
sonner/src/index.tsx is a substantial 30,900-byte typed interaction component; the dossier records 332 commits, 433 issues, 341 PRs, and follow-up fixes through 2026-08-10.

vaul/src/index.tsx is a 38,337-byte typed drawer implementation exposing controlled state, gesture thresholds, snap points, nesting, modal behavior, scroll/keyboard handling, and directionality; its commit history includes concrete Safari, Firefox, transform, and initialization fixes.
The two code repositories account for 21,387 stars and 816 forks; Sonner alone has 12,835 stars and 456 forks, while Vaul has 8,552 stars and 360 forks.
against: All public original repositories postdate the November 2022 cutoff; the pre-AI score therefore uses substitute evidence from detailed stateful code, tests, and incremental maintenance rather than direct pre-AI history.

The main implementation files are very large (Sonner src/index.tsx at 30,900 bytes and Vaul src/index.tsx at 38,337 bytes), indicating some concentration of concerns rather than uniformly small module boundaries.
Vaul is explicitly marked unmaintained in its README, and its last push was 2025-10-03.
